newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: Argentine grain output 60-70 mln T by 2000 - Menem.
newsitem.headline: Argentine grain output 60-70 mln T by 2000 - Menem.

text.p: Argentina's production of grains should grow to 60-70 million tonnes by the end of the century, President Carlos Menem said on Friday.

"We all know the virtues of our land, and I calculate at least between 60 million and 70 million tonnes by the year 2000. I don't think we are going to produce less, but that we will grow still more," Menem said, quoted by the state-run Telam news agency.
The government estimates 1996/97 grain output at about 56 million tonnes, which would easily beat the previous record of 46 million tonnes in 1995/95.
Farm output has soared since the stabilization of the Argentine economy encouraged big investment in the land.
